entries.title: Psalms 59:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. Set to "Do Not Destroy." A Michtam of David when Saul sent men, and they watched the the house in order to kill him.>> Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; Defend me from those who rise up against me.

entries.title: Psalms 59:2
segments: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, And save me from bloodthirsty men.

entries.title: Psalms 59:3
segments: For look, they lie in wait for my life; The mighty gather against me, Not [for] my transgression nor [for] my sin, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 59:4
segments: They run and prepare themselves through no fault [of mine]. Awake to help me, and behold!

entries.title: Psalms 59:5
segments: You therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, Awake to punish all the nations; Do not be merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 59:6
segments: At evening they return, They growl like a dog, And go all around the city.

entries.title: Psalms 59:7
segments: Indeed, they belch with their mouth; Swords [are] in their lips; For [they say], "Who hears?"

entries.title: Psalms 59:8
segments: ¶But You, O LORD, shall laugh at them; You shall have all the nations in derision.

entries.title: Psalms 59:9
segments: I will wait for You, [O You] his Strength; For God [is] my defense;

entries.title: Psalms 59:10
segments: My God of mercy shall come to meet me; God shall let me see [my desire] on my enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 59:11
segments: Do not slay them, lest my people forget; Scatter them by Your power, And bring them down, O Lord our shield.

entries.title: Psalms 59:12
segments: [For] the sin of their mouth [and] the words of their lips, Let them even be taken in their pride, And for the cursing and lying [which] they speak.

entries.title: Psalms 59:13
segments: Consume [them] in wrath, consume [them], That they [may] not [be]; And let them know that God rules in Jacob To the ends of the earth. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 59:14
segments: And at evening they return, They growl like a dog, And go all around the city.

entries.title: Psalms 59:15
segments: They wander up and down for food, And howl if they are not satisfied.

entries.title: Psalms 59:16
segments: But I will sing of Your power; Yes, I will sing aloud of Your mercy in the morning; For You have been my defense And refuge in the day of my trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 59:17
segments: To You, O my Strength, I will sing praises; For God [is] my defense, My God of mercy.
